camel_example: aliyun live DeleteLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest
description_zh: 调用DeleteLiveMessageGroup删除互动消息群组
kebab_example: aliyun live delete-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteLiveMessageGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the group that you want to delete
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who performs the deletion operation. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain only letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 操作者ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节，后台会记录操作者ID
parameters.name: operator_id

parameters.help_en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the deleted or non-existent group
GroupId.description_zh: 已删除的或者不存在的群组ID
